scope: 212 test cases from TestCases_V2.csv (192 flow rows: FareConfirm-based 25-72, Upselling-based 73-120; 20 endpoint cases): SabreNdc / EGY on staging
title_line: SabreNdc / EGY - TestCases_V2.csv (V2 flows and endpoint cases)
scope_text: 212 test cases from TestCases_V2.csv (192 flow rows: FareConfirm-based 25-72, Upselling-based 73-120; 20 endpoint cases): SabreNdc / EGY on staging
description_text: V2 flows and V2-only endpoint cases run against SabreNdc with the EGY credentials selector. SabreNdc supports no bundles, ancillaries or seat maps, so those enrichment flows are reported as blocked.

steps: Ran V2 Search on 7 routes (CAI-JED, CAI-DOH, DOH-CAI, CAI-JFK, CAI-LHR, CAI-DXB, JED-CAI) for SabreNdc/EGY and read the per-offer flags on all 144 offers: haveBundles, offerHasAncillary, offerHasSeat and isSeatMapRequired are false on every offer, canBeHeld is true on every offer.
FareConfirm re-confirmed the same flags on the selected offer (SPEC 4.7 procedure).

Called Upselling (V1 + V2), GetOfferBundles, AddPassenger, GetAncillary, GetSeatMap and FareCheck once each: Upselling returns 200 with 6 upsell offers; GetOfferBundles, GetAncillary, GetSeatMap and FareCheck all return 409 OperationNotSupported ("SabreNdc does not exists").

Concluded that the Bundle, Ancillary and SeatMap enrichment flows cannot run on SabreNdc/EGY and that only the no-enrichment families (A-F, FareConfirm and Upselling paths) can be executed end to end.
